items.problem: Bootstrap silently omitted source linked from outside the UWP project directory.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 399-415 copied only 7 files; lines 692-739 show external SharedContent Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition entries; turns 7-25 manually copied and repaired those files.
items.skill_search: Searched Initialize-UwpMigration.ps1 for SharedContent, Link, Compile Include, ApplicationDefinition Include, and Page Include; no linked-item handling existed.
items.root_cause: The bootstrap inventory was a recursive directory walk rather than the union of project-local files and csproj-linked inputs.
items.proposed_fix: Resolve external project item Include paths and Link destinations, copy them before rewrite/triage, and fail on unresolved linked inputs.
items.generalizes: Old non-SDK UWP projects commonly share App, shell, styles, and assets through linked MSBuild items.

items.problem: The skill required a nonexistent winapp build command and launch discovery rejected default dotnet Debug layouts.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3301-3349 show no winapp build command; lines 3354-3362 show Test-AppLaunch reporting no bin\x64\Debug output.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, Validate-UwpMigration.ps1, and Test-AppLaunch.ps1 for winapp build, dotnet build, binCandidates, and bin\Debug.
items.wrong_text_if_any: Prefer `winapp build` to compile; Test-AppLaunch searched only bin/<arch>/Debug.
items.root_cause: Build instructions and output discovery assumed a winapp CLI surface and one platform-qualified output shape.
items.proposed_fix: Use native dotnet build guidance and accept both platform-qualified and default Debug output roots.
items.generalizes: winapp command versions vary, and plain dotnet builds commonly emit bin\Debug.

items.problem: UWP suspension persistence was neither detected nor explained.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3409-3412 and 3537-3539 show missing Application.Suspending; turn 17 added a never-raised event to compile.
items.skill_search: Searched SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and unsupported-api-inventory.json for Suspending, SuspendingEventHandler, and SuspendingOperation; no matches existed.
items.root_cause: The lifecycle pattern covered activation but not UWP suspension, and the inventory injected no lifecycle TODO.
items.proposed_fix: Route suspension constructs to the lifecycle anchor and document incremental persistence plus Window.Closed/AppWindow.Closing.
items.generalizes: UWP apps frequently save state from Application.Suspending, while WinUI 3 desktop has no equivalent event.
